title: Wonderful for small families in apartments.
text:
Wonderful for small families in apartments.. I've had this table for about 6 months now. We're a family of 3. This fits all of us well and still room for one more. Plus you could squeeze in maybe a 5th person with a chair and it would still be a great table.

It's sturdy, easy to assemble, and so far, it seems like it will last.
My only complaint would be that there are heat circles marked on the table so if the light reflects on it, you can tell. Over time, this is now a pattern with as many plates as we've placed on it over the last 6 months.

Still, for less than $200, this is a steal. It can last a long time. If you are worried about the heat circles, put a table cloth over it :)
